description:
An e-commerce company has a comprehensive order fulfillment process:
When a customer places an order, the system records the order details.
Payment processing begins.
If the payment fails, the customer is notified, and the process ends.
Upon successful payment, the inventory system checks stock availability.
If items are out of stock, a back-order is initiated, and the customer is informed about the delay.
The process continues once the back-order is received and all required items are available in stock.
In-stock items are picked from the warehouse.
Quality control checks are performed on the picked items.
Packaging is done, including gift wrapping if the customer requested it.
Meanwhile, the shipping department prepares shipping documents and labels.
If the order is international, customs documentation is prepared.
Once packaging and shipping documents are ready, the order is dispatched.
The system sends a shipping confirmation to the customer.
After dispatch, the system updates the inventory levels.
A follow-up email for feedback is sent directly after confirming the successful delivery.
If the customer reports any issues upon delivery, a returns process is initiated, which includes:
Sending a return shipping label.
Receiving returned items.
Inspecting returned items.
Processing a refund or replacement.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BackorderReceived" name="Back-order received"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="E-commerce company" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_OrderPlaced"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentFailed" name="Payment failure notice" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailed" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShippingConfirmation" name="Shipping confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FeedbackEmail" name="Feedback request" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderPlaced" messageRef="Message_OrderPlaced"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order details"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProcessPayment" name="Process payment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentSplit" name="Payment successful?" default="Flow_PaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyPaymentFailed" name="Notify customer of payment failure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentFailed" name="Order terminated: payment failed"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock availability"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockSplit" name="Items out of stock?" default="Flow_InStock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InitiateBackorder" name="Initiate back-order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformDelay" name="Inform customer about delay"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BackorderReceived" name="Back-order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BackorderReceived" messageRef="Message_BackorderReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Stock available"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick items from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_QualityCheck" name="Perform quality control check"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PackagingSplit" name="Start packaging and shipping preparation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftSplit" name="Gift wrap requested?" default="Flow_NoGiftWrap"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiftWrap" name="Gift wrap items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftMerge" name="Gift wrap decision done"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackOrder" name="Pack order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShippingDocs" name="Prepare shipping documents and labels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalSplit" name="International order?" default="Flow_Domestic"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CustomsDocs" name="Prepare customs documentation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalMerge" name="Customs check done"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DispatchJoin" name="Packaging and shipping documents ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DispatchOrder" name="Dispatch order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" name="Send shipping confirmation to customer"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm successful delivery"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IssueSplit" name="Customer reported issue?" default="Flow_NoIssue"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" name="Send feedback follow-up email"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Returns" name="Returns process">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Sub_Start_Returns" name="Return initiated"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SendReturnLabel" name="Send return shipping label"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" name="Receive returned items"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectReturnedItems" name="Inspect returned items"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RefundOrReplace" name="Process refund or replacement"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="Sub_End_Returns" name="Returns processed"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ret_1" sourceRef="Sub_Start_Returns" targetRef="Task_SendReturnLabel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ret_2" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ret_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ret_4" sourceRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_RefundOrReplace"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ret_5" sourceRef="Task_RefundOrReplace" targetRef="Sub_End_Returns"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReturnsHandled" name="Returns handled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ProcessPayment" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentOK" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckStock">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${paymentSuccessful == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentFailed" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailed" targetRef="End_PaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutOfStock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_InitiateBackorder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${itemsOutOfStock == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_InitiateBackorder" targetRef="Task_InformDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Event_BackorderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Event_BackorderReceived" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_QualityCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_QualityCheck" targetRef="Gateway_PackagingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_PackagingSplit" targetRef="Gateway_GiftSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_PackagingSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftYes" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftSplit" targetRef="Task_GiftWrap">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${giftWrapRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGiftWrap" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftSplit" targetRef="Gateway_GiftMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_GiftMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftMerge" targetRef="Task_PackOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocs" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intl" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalSplit" targetRef="Task_CustomsDocs">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${internationalOrder == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Domestic" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_CustomsDocs" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge" targetRef="Gateway_DispatchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_PackOrder" targetRef="Gateway_DispatchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Gateway_DispatchJoin" targetRef="Task_DispatchOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_DispatchOrder" targetRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Gateway_IssueSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssueReported" sourceRef="Gateway_IssueSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_Returns">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${issueReported == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoIssue" sourceRef="Gateway_IssueSplit" targetRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_35" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="End_OrderCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="SubProcess_Returns" targetRef="End_ReturnsHandled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
